a: Synthetic transactions continuously exercise critical user journeys.
Limit blast radius so experiments do not take down everything.
Game days rehearse incident response with planned failures.
Automated canary analysis compares metrics before promoting.
Use realistic traffic shapes, not only constant RPS.
Soak tests run for long periods to find leaks and degradation.
Spike tests suddenly increase load to test elasticity.
Factories generate varied valid test entities.
Evolve contracts with additive changes when possible.
Assert on logs/metrics in integration tests when useful.
